Keep your pup’s smile bright and breath fresh with Pawstruck Daily Dental Brush Chews! Designed for everyday use, these easy-to-digest treats help fight tartar, control plaque, and support overall oral health between brushings.

Made in the USA with globally sourced ingredients, these gluten-, wheat-, and corn-free chews contain no artificial additives. Unique ridges and nodules gently clean teeth, break down tartar, and help prevent dental issues like gingivitis and inflammation.

Limited ingredients like parsley, cumin, and potato flour add flavor while promoting digestive health and fresh breath. Unlike rawhide, these chews are gentle on sensitive stomachs and safe for daily enjoyment.

Affordable, effective, and palatable, Pawstruck Daily Dental Brush Chews make it easy to keep your dog healthy and happy—without breaking the bank. Give your pup a chew that’s as good for their teeth as it is for their tail-wagging enjoyment.
